_doc: They are asked alongside the hazard primitives and never raise the level themselves (severity 0);
`pairs` lists which hazard primitives each one may inhibit: p_j <- p_j * (1 - alpha_j * p_c(j)).

primitives.question: Is any bright or shiny area on the floor in this image only a normal reflection of light on a smooth floor, rather than real water or oil on the ground?
Is any smoke or vapor visible in this image only normal process steam or exhaust (for example from a slag pot, furnace, cooling tower or industrial pipe), rather than smoke from a fire?
Are the red objects in this image only normal fire-safety equipment, such as a closed hydrant cabinet or a fire extinguisher?
